name: Ironfray Grow
lines: The Gullwrack Coast
Sea cliffs over a grey beach, sea stacks in the surf and caves at the cliff foot. Sky-pirates' boarders come ashore against the Coast Watch's musketeers.
Wreckers come up the strand at the Coast Watch. Fight from the rocks, or from the wreck.
The shallows under the cliffs: giant crabs, and the Crab King in his shell of barnacles.
A fishing hamlet on the cliff top: nets drying, a smokehouse, a lighthouse that still burns.
The Frostfang Reach
Snowfields and dark pines, a frozen lake, crags of blue ice and caves in the drifts. Northern raiders against the Azure wardens; wolves and yetis in the high snow.
The raiders of the north storm the wardens' ice wall. Pines and drifts to hide in.
High snow where the wolf packs run, yetis walk, and Old Tusk the great mammoth will not be driven off.
A log steading on the lake shore: trappers, a smithy with its fire always lit, sledges.
The Highmoor Downs
Rolling moor, heather and long grass, dry-stone walls, a ring of standing stones and a ruined abbey. Knights against the legions; wild boar in the bracken.
The legion marches on the knights by the old abbey. Walls to crouch behind, long grass to vanish in.
Deep bracken where the wild boar root, and the Boar King keeps his wallow.
A farming hamlet in the lee of the hill: cottages, a barn, a well, sheep on the down.
The Blackroot Weald
Old forest, close and dark: ferns to the waist, fallen giants you can crawl into, a ravine. Rangers against the shadow-blades; bears and wolves.
Wardens of the wood against the shadow-blades. Every tree is cover, every fern a hiding place.
The ravine's caves: bears, wolves, and Grimmaw the dire bear.
A woodcutters' camp in a clearing: a sawpit, stacked timber, a charcoal burner's clamp.
Black pools and reed beds, boardwalks, stilt huts and sunken boats, mist on the water. The drowned dead and their necromancers against the paladins.
The Sunken Causeway
Paladins hold the causeway against the drowned and their masters. Wade, or crouch in the reeds.
The deep mire: giant rats, lizard-kin, wraiths over the water, and the Drowned King.
Stilt houses joined by boardwalks: eel traps, punts, a lamp at every door.
The Emberfall Caldera
Black rock and ash, cinder cones, rivers of lava, columns of basalt and lava tubes to hide in. Fire-sworn oni against the battle-mages. The lava burns: keep out of it.
The mages hold the cinder front against the oni. Basalt to hide behind; the lava burns.
Vents of fire: fire spirits, imps, stone golems, and Magmaw the molten colossus.
A forge camp on the rim, where the smiths work obsidian and fire-steel.
The Shatterstone Badlands
Red mesas and canyons, hoodoos, old mine adits. Riflemen and heavy gunners against war robots and spider-bots.
The machines come down the canyon. Mesas to climb, hoodoos and adits to hide in.
An old mine works run wild with machines, and the Iron Colossus that guards it.
A mining camp in the gulch: a headframe, ore carts, a cook-tent.
The Redsand Expanse
Great dunes, an oasis with its palms, and a temple half buried in the sand. Desert riders against the lizard-kin; scorpions in the deep sand.
The riders fight the lizard-kin for the half-buried temple. Dune crests block every line of sight.
The deep dunes: giant scorpions, and Queen Sandmaw under the sand.
A caravan stop at the oasis: tents, camels' lines, a well, a market of a dozen stalls.
